title: Macro-Operator Generation and Predicate Selection for TAMP Operator Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.23629v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Creating symbolic operators by hand is one of the main bottlenecks in deploying Task and Motion Planning systems (TAMP). Recent works show that these operators can instead be learned directly from demonstration data. Existing methods, however, typically learn each action in isolation and cannot capture the recurring multi-step structure of manipulation tasks, so the search becomes intractable on long sequential tasks. A further inefficiency arises in the symbolic state: every provided predicate is evaluated at every search node, even when it never appears in any learned operator. We present a system that addresses both problems together. Its central component is the automatic generation of macro-operators, composite actions that compress a recurring sequence of individual actions into a single planning step. translated_title: 宏操作符生成与谓词选择用于TAMP操作符学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23629v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：手动创建符号操作符是部署任务与运动规划系统（TAMP）的主要瓶颈之一。近期研究表明，这些操作符可以直接从演示数据中学习。然而，现有方法通常孤立地学习每个动作，无法捕捉操作任务中重复出现的多步结构，导致在长序列任务中搜索变得难以处理。另一个低效问题出现在符号状态中：每个提供的谓词在每个搜索节点都会被评估，即使它从未出现在任何学习到的操作符中。我们提出一个系统，同时解决这两个问题。其核心组件是宏操作符的自动生成，即复合动作，将重复出现的单个动作序列压缩为单个规划步骤。我们的系统直接从训练数据中发现因果关联的动作对，其中一个动作精确产生条件。
tldr: 本文提出一个TAMP操作符学习系统，通过自动生成宏操作符压缩重复动作序列，并选择相关谓词以减少搜索开销，从而提升长序列任务的规划效率。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a TAMP operator learning system that automatically generates macro-operators to compress recurring action sequences and selects relevant predicates to reduce search overhead, improving planning efficiency on long-horizon tasks.
